summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Jun 9, 2026): 24 unserviced first-come sites C$20, self-registration; vault toilets, hand-pump drinking water, picnic shelter; season May 5 - Oct 31 unchanged; phone 780-325-2270 confirmed. Not waterfront. Pin sits on Hwy 16; campground ~200 m north-east.
flags: PIN (53.60944,-115.60473): on the Hwy 16 carriageway at a median crossover. The campsites are clearings in the pine strip on the north side of the highway; the page's directions point 53.609905,-115.601866 is at their east end (~195 m away) and the clearings' centre is about 53.6100,-115.6015 (~220 m). Recommend moving the pin to 53.60995,-115.60170.
